audience_description: Foundation Representatives / General Managers (FR/GM) in Eduversal partner schools — the highest school-level governance authority (Career Growth Framework 26-27). Owns: governance oversight, the financial-reporting interface, strategic alignment, and stakeholder management with the yayasan board. In the annual Principal Appraisal the FR/GM is the governance-side co-reviewer and summary co-signer; the Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director is the primary appraiser (Principal Appraisal: Handbook 26-27 §7). NOT operational — strategic and oversight-focused.

regulatory_anchors.title: Permendikbud 75/2016 — Komite Sekolah
regulatory_anchors.relevance: School committee (Komite Sekolah) — parent and community participation in school governance.

regulatory_anchors.title: Permendikdasmen 7/2025 — Penugasan Guru sebagai Kepala Sekolah
regulatory_anchors.relevance: Principal appointment regulation — yayasan oversight role.

framework_anchors.cambridge_school_leader_standards_2023: Anchored in ethics & professional norms + meaningful engagement of community.
framework_anchors.principal_appraisal_v1: Foundation Representative / General Manager is the governance-side co-reviewer and summary co-signer of the annual Principal Appraisal; the Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director is the primary appraiser (Principal Appraisal: Handbook 26-27 §7).

priority_levels.compliance: Required by yayasan-school agreement or Indonesian regulation. Non-negotiable.

recurring_tasks.title: Weekly governance pulse review
recurring_tasks.description: Review the school's weekly governance digest from the Academic Coordinator. Flag any items requiring yayasan visibility.

monthly_tasks.title: Monthly yayasan briefing
monthly_tasks.description: Brief the yayasan board on school performance, risks, and strategic items. Use anonymised aggregate data only — no individual teacher data per Section 11.8 transparency rules.

monthly_tasks.title: Attend monthly ALT Dashboard Review
monthly_tasks.description: Sit in on the monthly ALT meeting where Principal + ALT review the leadership dashboard. Foundation Rep participates as observer + strategic advisor.

monthly_tasks.title: Monthly RKAS execution review
monthly_tasks.description: Co-review RKAS execution with Principal and bendahara. Ensure financial stewardship aligns with the yayasan-approved annual plan.

termly_tasks.title: Co-review Quarterly Academic Review (QAR) output with yayasan
termly_tasks.description: After Principal+Coordinator complete QAR, present QAR Findings to yayasan board. Include strategic implications for next quarter.

termly_tasks.title: Principal Appraisal — governance co-review and co-sign (year end)
termly_tasks.description: At year end, after the Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director signs off the Principal's annual appraisal, open the governance summary in Principal Evaluation: the composite score, the A–F band, the recommendation (continue / development_plan / non_renewal) and the agreed next-year goals. Check that the process was fair and evidence-based, then co-sign the summary. You do not review or re-score item-level evidence (Principal Appraisal: Handbook 26-27 §7, §13).
evidence_required: Governance summary co-signed in Academic Hub
termly_tasks.first_time_guide: You are the governance-side co-reviewer and summary co-signer, not the appraiser or an observer: the leadership-observation visits (F2) and the full record belong to the Chief Academic Officer / designated Academic Director. You receive only the summary triplet and agreed goals — never item-level scores, P1–P8 observation notes, F3 area scores or individual 360 responses. You never see coaching content; do not ask for it.

tasks.title: Co-sign approved RKT/RKAS for the year
tasks.description: Verify alignment with yayasan strategic plan. Co-sign the school's annual operating plan + budget.

tasks.title: Attend Eduversal Annual School Leadership Workshop
tasks.description: All Foundation Reps attend the Eduversal-led annual workshop. Hear network priorities, share school perspectives, align next-year strategy.

tasks.title: Attend the School Appraisal Phase 1 — Teaching Quality Visit meetings
tasks.description: Phase 1 is on-site, in the live window 5 August – 18 September 2026 (the school's exact date is in its own schedule). The foundation representative attends the Presentation & Discussion of School Programs, the Domain Meetings with School Management, the Oral Exit Report and the Post-Appraisal Meeting with School Management.

tasks.title: Attend the School Appraisal Phase 3 — Validation Visit meetings
tasks.description: Phase 3 is on-site, in the live window 7 October – 20 November 2026, and validates the school's Self-Evaluation. The foundation representative attends the Domain Meetings with School Management, the Oral Exit Report and the Post-Appraisal Meeting. The Annual School Quality Report follows within three weeks, with a Development Rating for each of the five domains — there is no composite school score.

tasks.title: Sem-1 yayasan board strategic review
tasks.description: Present Sem-1 strategic review to yayasan board: SIP progress, financial position, risks, Sem-2 priorities.

tasks.title: Attend mid-year Eduversal network leadership conference
tasks.description: Mid-year alignment with Eduversal on network direction, Sem-1 Common Assessment results, principal cohort health.

tasks.title: Annual Report to Yayasan Board
tasks.description: Comprehensive annual report: academic results, financial position, staff matters, infrastructure, strategic outlook. Drives yayasan-school agreement renewal where relevant.

tasks.title: Annual visi-misi review co-leadership
tasks.description: Co-lead annual review of the school's vision, mission, and core values with Principal and yayasan. Confirm continued relevance or propose revision.

extra_tasks_first_12_weeks.title: Quarterly orientation with Eduversal Director
extra_tasks_first_12_weeks.description: First-year Foundation Reps meet quarterly with Eduversal Director (Primary or Secondary, matching school stage) — orientation to the network operating model, governance expectations, and the Academic Quality Ecosystem (the five Academic Services modules — Curriculum, Induction, EASE, Appraisal, Career Growth — and the Student Learning layer).

reads_from: Principal Annual Appraisal triplet (triplet-only yayasan boundary)

provenance.framework_sources: Eduversal Network Standards, Cambridge School Leader Standards 2023
provenance.operational_pattern_source: Eduversal-network role definition. Less Semesta-direct than other roles — Foundation Rep is yayasan-side, not academic-side, so Semesta's HoD/Coord patterns adapt only in the strategic-oversight slice.
